Messages.Body:
Khazar's Diary (Endless Night)
Action
Giovanni
+1 stealth action.
***Put the Diary in play, or add a counter to one in play.*** When a
unique minion in play is burned, add another counter. While this card
has seven or more counters, Giovanni get [NEC] and may take a +1
stealth action to put a minion from any ash heap into play to
represent a wraith ally with 2 life, 0 strength, 1 bleed and +1
stealth.

Emphasis mine. Does this mean you can add multiple Diaries into play,
which will then have a cumulative effect?

As it states put the Diary in play OR add a counter, it implies a
choice. Nowhere does it state I may not put it inplay a second time,
and as it is not unique there is no limit to this.

If the answer to the above is yes, would this mean that multiple
Diries with 7+ counters each would give +x stealth etc to each wraith
where x is the number of 7+ counter Diaries in play?

> It says: You create a wraith ally with the following stats
> not: You create a wraith ally and all wraith allies get the following

Correct. Meaning the +1 stealth doesn't accumulate ("stack") on each wraith.
The effect is not "Wraith allies get +1 stealth".

The card lets you create a wraith with 2 life, 0 strength, 1 bleed, and +1 stealth.

You may create that wraith with Diary A or with Diary B. A wraith created by the
action provided by Diary A won't be affected by the life, strength, bleed, or
stealth that would be given to a wraith created by Diary B.

Similarly, a vampire with 2 Haven Uncovereds on him can be rushed via Haven A or
Haven B, but the rush provided by Rush A is at +1 stealth, not +2 stealth; the
stealth provided by Haven B for its action cannot be used on the rush action
provided by Haven A.
